definition: An unsupervised learning technique that groups data points into clusters based on similarity, without predefined labels.
details: Common clustering algorithms include k-means and hierarchical clustering, used for tasks like customer segmentation, anomaly detection, and exploratory data analysis.
story: Picture a librarian organizing a million slips of paper so that any one of them can be found in a heartbeat. The examples a machine reads become the world it believes in. Better ingredients make a better meal, and the same is true here. Garbage in, garbage out — and the reverse: clean, representative data makes the model quietly brilliant. And that is Clustering — the unglamorous work everything else stands on.
